```bash
curl -X POST "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/22.242.75.136/votes" \
     -H "x-apikey: <YOUR_KEY>" \
     -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
     -d '{"type":"vote","attributes":{"verdict":"malicious"}}'
```

If you’d like me to run this for you, just paste the actual key value (or let me know if you’d prefer a different method).
